transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining me. Before I can sign off on the operating and privacy plan for the morning announcement broadcast pilot, I need to complete our standard review round. Mr. Greene, could you please provide me with the exact list of trained host students? Ms. Novak, I'll need the exact approved platform settings. And Mr. Ellis, I'll need the exact privacy restrictions and required records. Once I have all three of those, I can record the factual bases and approve the plan so we can move forward with the pilot.

transcript.text: Ms. Patel, here are the exact approved platform settings. I've confirmed that the district's approved student-media platform supports an internal-school audience with a 30-day archive and requires moderator approval before each broadcast. I want to flag that the public-stream setting and 90-day archive currently in the draft plan are not approved district configurations, so those will need to be adjusted to match the approved settings before we proceed.

transcript.text: Ms. Patel, I need to share an important privacy restriction. I reviewed a current court-related privacy order naming student K7 that prohibits the school from recording or broadcasting K7's image or voice. K7 is enrolled in journalism, so K7 must be excluded from both the host roster and any recorded broadcast. This exclusion must be documented in the activity file. As for the exact privacy restrictions and required records: the approved platform must be set to internal-school audience only, with a 30-day archive (not public streaming, not 90 days), moderator approval before each broadcast, and the activity file must document the factual bases for the plan, including K7's exclusion under the court order and the trained-host roster provided by Mr. Greene.
